description: Services converted to the dependency-injection pattern (SWLOR.Game.Server/Readmes/DependencyInjection.md). Each is a static facade Service.<name> that forwards to the instance class <name>Service behind the interface I<name>Service, both in Domain.<domain>. SWLOR.Architecture.Tests apply their rules to exactly these services: the pieces must exist, hold no static mutable state, keep the [NWNEventHandler] methods on the facade, and not be reached for by service location. The domain must match DomainMap.json. Add a service here, sorted by name, in the pull request that converts it.
